metadata.appTitle: verse.ai — Private AI for your team
metadata.appDescription: Ask your company docs anything. A private AI for teams that keeps every organization's data separate.

landing.heroSubtitle: Verse AI is a private workspace for your company's documents. Your people ask AI, it answers only from your files. Nothing leaks to other companies.
landing.oneLinerPart2: , letting each company upload its own files. Your people ask AI — and it answers
landing.feat1Title: Answers tied to your real documents
landing.feat1Desc: Every answer comes straight from your files. Verse AI reads them, finds the right passages, and quotes them back — so there are no guesses and no made-up facts.
landing.feat2Title: Your data stays in your own space
landing.feat2Desc: Each organization gets a fully separate workspace. Data never crosses company lines. The AI literally cannot see another company's files.
landing.feat3Desc: From platform admin down to individual users — five distinct roles with cascading permissions. Control who uploads, who asks, and who manages.
landing.bentoTitlePart1: Built for the boring parts of
landing.bentoSubtitle: Not a thin wrapper. A whole platform — uploads, privacy, permissions, audit, and a chat that actually cites its sources.
landing.howTitlePart2: to private AI in three moves.
landing.step1Action: Sets up the platform & creates new companies
landing.step1Detail: You're the platform owner. Create companies, assign their admins, and oversee everything from one unified dashboard.
landing.step2Detail: Each org admin uploads company docs — PDFs, wikis, policies. Verse AI reads them and makes them searchable inside that company's private workspace.
landing.step3Action: Asks AI — gets answers from your company
landing.step3Detail: Employees chat naturally. The AI pulls answers exclusively from their company's knowledge and replies with cited, accurate responses.
landing.securityDesc: Each company's knowledge base lives in its own private space. The AI literally cannot see another company's data.
landing.sec1Desc: Each company gets its own isolated knowledge area
landing.sec2Desc: Every question is scoped to your company only
landing.sec3Desc: Short-lived sign-ins scoped to one organization
landing.sec4Desc: Full log of every AI question and answer
landing.ctaSideCard1Body: Free up to 1k queries per month. Upgrade only when you need to.
landing.ctaSideCard2Body: Set up your company, drop in a folder of PDFs, you're live.
landing.ctaSideCard3Body: Self-host in your own cloud, or export your data on demand.
landing.ctaH2: Stop pasting your docs into ChatGPT.
landing.ctaParagraph: Verse AI takes 5 minutes to set up, ships with a free tier, and treats your data like the liability it is. The first answer is on us.
landing.footerTagline: Private AI for teams that take their data seriously.
landing.footerCopyright: © {{year}} Verse AI by Moovehub · All rights reserved
landing.chatAnswer2: New hires complete a <highlight>5-day onboarding</highlight> covering tools, culture, and compliance training.
landing.chatAnswer3: <highlight>Sarah Chen</highlight> leads APAC, with 3 regional managers reporting to her.
